{"concern":"usability","kind":"functional","lineage":"original","name":"The site shows why reflow2 is more than a record of decisions: each one is kept as a typed, linked record that reflow2 checks and reasons over, and one small decision at a time adds up to a design nobody could hold in their head. Shown with reflow2's own design, counted when the site is published","priority":"high","provenance":"authored","source":"Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-13, reading flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2","statement":"reflow2's site keeps its plain first explanation (the person decides, the AI helps, reflow2 remembers why), and adds the half it undersells:
- A decision is not a row in a table. It is a record of a known kind, linked by named relations to what it rests on, what it satisfies, what checks it, what it caused and what it replaced. reflow2 refuses what does not fit, and it answers from the links what a table cannot: what a change will reach, which requirement nothing satisfies, which decisions rest on something that just failed, and what has never been asked.
- Small decisions add up. Each one is cheap and kept with its reason, and together they make a design space nobody planned whole, which is the tinkering in Taleb's convex tinkering. reflow2's own design is the evidence. The numbers on the page are counted from its committed design when the site is published, never typed by hand. Bookkeeping links (release manifests) are counted apart from the links of meaning, so the size is not inflated.

Anthony, 2026-10-13: "yes, it makes everything easy to understand, but undersells why it is powerful and much more complex than reflow2 simply recording decisions like some simple database. Probably have to look no further than reflow2 has how many nodes and edges now? ... I think this also shows the power of making one small decision at a time and how it adds up into complex things. It is the \"tinkering\" in Teleb's \"convexity tinkering\"...where a project is built up from hundreds or thousands of ideas and decisions all linked together in some crazy interplay design space. So yes, on one hand, it boils down to that reflow2 is the persistent memory of all the decisions, but on the other hand, it stores these thoughts and decisions in an organized/structured manner (nodes and edges which is more than a simple postgres db that just records everything) that make some simple, rudimentary set of human decisions and ideas into a powerful set of human invention and creation. ... it is more than just record"

Measured the same day on reflow2's own committed design at v0.83.5: 7,206 records of 23 kinds and 53,466 links of 49 kinds, of which 35,421 are release manifests. It held 342 records on 2026-07-24 (v0.10.0), after one week.

Via negativa, asked before this addition: the site gains no page. The home page's "remembers" framing is reworded to "remembers and connects", and the counted evidence goes on the page that already explains why.","status":"accepted"}
